landforms.reason: Gentle old-moraine terrace above the stream; orchard rows and apothecary garden sit on worked brown earth.
Tended herb/fruit garden beside the canonical apothecary anchor; fences and drying rack mark human care, not loot.
Shaded forest-floor margin where the canonical moonleaf nodes cluster; ferns and leaf litter explain the herb source.
Glacial cirque holds wind-packed snow around the shrine; the stone road is the maintained crossing.
Exposed arête is scoured to granite; warning cairns and sparse lee-side pines communicate cold exposure before the ridge.
Contact-metamorphic skarn exposes the canonical ore nodes; dark host rock makes the mineral veins readable without loot glow.
Lake-margin reed peat accumulates in shallow sheltered water beside the causeway.
Lacustrine silt lens exposed near the clay source and ferry approach.
Wave-cut shell bench below the lighthouse; silica placer sorts along the storm strand.
Wind-blown dune ridge shelters the approach from the exposed cliff.
Cooled basalt flow from the cinder cones; copper veins follow the flow margin.
Fumarole sublimation deposits sulfur crust around the vent field.
Terminal evaporite pan crusts over after dry wind; rakes and shade mark worked salt.
Calcareous dune margin shelters the caravan approach from glare.
Folded limestone ridge supports the canopy temple terraces.
Spore hollow discolours leaf litter; filter gear matters more than armour.
Distributary tidal channel scours mudflat beside the customs house; tide changes safe approach.
Shell hash bar marks the mollusc nursery and pearl bed.
Tower-karst sinkhole pools surface water before it disappears to the Ashwater resurgence.
Ruined orchard terraces hold rendzina soil and limestone quarry blocks.
Still toxic pools accumulate miasma; bleached reeds and gas bubbles telegraph the filter requirement.
Acid peat accumulation beside the pump station; bog iron precipitates at the redox margin.
